# Pivotal Tides

> Pivotal Tides is a private psychotherapy practice owned and operated by Angelique Danza, M.S., LMFT (CA LMFT112463), based in Temecula, CA. It offers depth-oriented, insight-focused therapy for individuals, couples, and groups, plus reproductive mental health support, serving Murrieta, Temecula, and the broader Inland Empire (in person and virtual).

- [Home](https://pivotaltides.com/): About the practice and Angelique Danza, LMFT.

- [Approach](https://pivotaltides.com/approach.html): The practice's therapeutic philosophy and modalities.
- [Rates & FAQ](https://pivotaltides.com/rates.html): Fees, insurance, and common questions.

- [Privacy Policy](https://pivotaltides.com/privacy-policy.html): How client information is handled.

## Clinician

- Name: Angelique Danza, M.S., LMFT
- License: CA LMFT112463 (Board of Behavioral Sciences)
- Certifications: Women's Mental Health & Reproductive Mental Health Specialist, Narcissistic Abuse Treatment, Anger Management
- Affiliations: CAMFT, ASRM
- Experience: 10+ years with children, adolescents, adults, couples, and groups

## Services & Rates

- Individual Therapy — $175 / 50-minute session
- Couples Therapy — $200 / 50-minute session
- Group Therapy — contact for current offerings
- Reproductive Support: Intended Parent (IP) & Gestational Carrier/Surrogate psychological assessments — contact for information
- Insurance: Aetna, Anthem Blue Cross, Carelon, Cigna/Evernorth, and out-of-network benefits

## Specialties

Women's issues, infertility, grief & loss, cancer psychotherapy, life transitions, relationship issues, anger management, family conflict, infidelity, marital & premarital, narcissistic abuse recovery, self-esteem, stress & burnout, identity & purpose, anxiety & depression, and reproductive/surrogacy support.
